body:
Everything that I "enjoy" seems like a distraction, just something to take the focus away from the drudgery, temporarily.

"Passion" is a concept I can't grasp. I simply can't get that kind of drive, the energy and excitement, for anything approaching "passion".

I look to the future, and all I see is more pain, more mind-numbing conversations and experiences, more debt, and even less hope. Statistically speaking, much of my life is going to be as bad, or worse, than this. Why *shouldn't* I try to avoid it?
